$comment: The 9 product IDs. Every English page in docs.json gets exactly one product: the first rule in 'rules' whose prefix matches the page path wins. A prefix ending in '/' matches a folder; otherwise it matches that exact page. 'skills' names the comfy-skills or comfy-cli skills that cover the product. Generated catalog/ pages are excluded.
